7830.title: Native browser close-command interception
7830.rootCauseOneLine: The native browser shortcut resolver skips panel.close before key matching, so Command+W is not consumed or dispatched to the renderer.
7830.proposedFix: Admit the existing panel.close command through the native-browser resolver; default and rebound regression cases fail before and pass after the one-line change.
7830.caveats: Reproduced the production routing failure in two clean checkouts, not the final native macOS window-close outcome. Full desktop packaging test is blocked by a missing system library, also on unchanged main. Test source and results are inline per reports repository policy.
